int_name: E ALLEGHENY AVE & N FRONT ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with significant pavement degradation and a lack of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the large expanse of unmarked asphalt increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching in the roadway can create tripping hazards and affect vehicle handling.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection and along the right curb line

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The curbs appear to be vertical without visible ramps, creating a barrier for people with mobility devices.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial with multiple travel lanes and on-street parking, creating a significant crossing distance for pedestrians. While marked crosswalks and sidewalks are present, the environment lacks high-visibility safety features like pedestrian signals, refuge islands, or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway and lack of a median or refuge island increase the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching drivers near the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a marked crosswalk on one leg but lacking markings on the others. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the large expanse of asphalt and lack of pedestrian refuge or curb extensions increases exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection creates a long, unprotected exposure time for pedestrians crossing the main roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main street

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: Only one leg of the intersection has visible zebra markings, leaving other crossing paths undefined for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility continental markings to all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and signalized control. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical protection like medians or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Separation
hazards.description: The wide roadway and lack of curb extensions or bollards provide little protection for pedestrians waiting at the corner.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left corners of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
